body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #2 (first US live run), company drawn at random (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.82 (naive base rate 0.60) that: Kirby FY2026 capital expenditures land inside the $220-260M guide. Our reasoning: 9M-2026 capex $189.3M, so Q4 must be $30.7-70.7M; Q4-25 was $47.0M, Q4-24 $96.7M; the guide was held unchanged in all four 2026 releases and Kirby hit its 2025 range ($264.5M vs $260-290M). Naive base: US industrials capex-range delivery in our credibility ledgers is weaker than margin delivery (pooled 'capacity/capex' 50%, insight:us-industrials-promise-credibility-base-rate); 0.60 blends that with Kirby's 2025 hit [EST]. Resolution: YES if FY2026 capital expenditures (PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets, or PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment if tagged; acquisitions excluded), first reported in the FY2026 10-K XBRL, are between $220M and $260M inclusive. Source: SEC XBRL companyfacts (10-K FY2026). Resolve by 2027-03-31; score with Brier vs the base rate to test whether deep-dive probabilities beat naive base rates.
